featured_reviews.name: Sonam Burde
featured_reviews.review_text:
We hired Event Factory for my child’s birthday on an open lawn in May after Parag claimed to provide “360° event management.” Since I am pregnant, I specifically wanted complete coordination support so the event could be stress-free. Unfortunately, the experience was extremely disappointing.

Despite detailed discussions, layouts, and repeated follow-ups from our side, there was poor planning, no budget clarity till 2 last days, and major time management issues.

On the day of the event:

1. The team arrived late and setup was incomplete when guests started arriving.

2. Guests got confused whether the event was at the lawn or our home because decoration was not ready, and many started coming directly to our house.

3. Main entrance decor and welcome curtains were completed after guests had already arrived.

4. Carpet taping came off and created inconvenience for guests.

5. Vendors like photographers and face artists were calling us directly because arrangements and coordination were not managed.

6. Lighting was extremely poor — the photographer himself mentioned this, and most of our event photos turned out dark.

7. Catering placement was not cordinate they were far placed and caused delays.

8. Stall boards and return gift signage were missing despite clear instructions.

9. We had informed in advance about music performances arranged by our friends, but no support or coordination was provided. After cake cutting, there was no music management support at all.

10. Decoration was heavily charged. Only main stage was covered which looked ok, but not neat and not worth the price. Additional costs kept getting added separately.

The only positive aspect was the anchor, who did a wonderful job keeping the kids engaged and joyful throughout the event.

Overall, the experience reflected poor planning, weak coordination, last-minute execution, and lack of ownership. Event Factory felt more like an expensive decoration provider rather than a true event management company.

For the amount spent, the experience was stressful instead of memorable. Sadly, we are left with very few good photos and disappointing memories from an important family event.
